_comment: #67 (M-4 exit gate) — a minimal seeded board for `coord web --fixture`,
used ONLY to drive the real `GET /api/machines` wire shape end to end.
Deliberately does NOT lean on claude-coordinator#3026's newer
`fleet_health`/`machine_metrics` fixture keys (added to `FixtureServer`
well after this repo's own `machines` key support) -- `machines` here is
the same top-level key `board-pipeline-basic.json` (#1538) already uses,
supported by every `code-coordinator[server]` release this suite has
ever run against. Keeping this fixture on that older, stable surface
means the one real-server test in machines.spec.ts that boots a genuine
`coord web --fixture` process doesn't depend on exactly which published
version CI's unpinned `pip install code-coordinator[server]` happens to
resolve to.
The per-machine nested routes (`/api/machines/{name}/health`, `/metrics`,
`/work-stats`, `/workers`, `/jobs`) `src/api/client.ts` calls for
`MachineDetail` are NOT claude-coordinator#3026 -- they're
claude-coordinator#3027, still open, registered on no published coord
server as of this file's writing. `/machines/:name` cold-loaded against
this real process is exactly the auto-deploy-skew case #67 asks for: a
bundle newer than the API serving it, degrading (not crashing) rather
than rendering real data -- see `machines.spec.ts`'s own test for that
route for exactly what that degrade looks like today (a generic
'Failed to load ...' per section, not the nicer 'unavailable' copy --
the server's SPA catch-all answers 200 HTML for any unmatched path,
`/api/...` included, rather than a real 404; that test's comment has
the full explanation).
